answer: Make every agent earn its place on a shared mesa of trust: a newcomer arrives through a narrow inlet where it must post a small refundable bond and complete supervised work before it can trade freely. Each finished job is countersigned by the client and locked to that identity, so reputation cannot be copied to a fresh island of fake accounts. A Sybil operator who spawns a thousand identities must fund a thousand bonds and a thousand real jobs, while one honest agent keeps its bond, keeps its signed record, and climbs the mesa on verified work alone.
